corrections.finding: First signal.throwIfAborted occurs inside acquisition loop, after mkdir, host identity, orphan cleanup, self identity and deadline construction. Already-aborted calls can perform setup IO before observing cancellation. Candidate prose ordering that checks cancellation before host setup is inaccurate.
corrections.acceptance: PJ-T-LOCK must preserve this source characterization and separately test intended abort-before-effects behavior if corrected.

corrections.finding: Unreadable Chromium metrics breadcrumb coalesces for 60000ms, not five seconds. Five seconds is SELF_TREE_KILL_LOOKBACK_MS used for PID-addressed attempt/refusal records; group kill coalescing also uses60000ms. The function name is readOrcaChromiumProcessPids, not getOrcaChromiumProcessPids.
corrections.acceptance: Retain exact timers and distinct record types in baseline and port.

corrections.finding: Recovery writes its wx/0600 claimant record BEFORE renaming the owner witness, then marks the in-process claim active. Keep this ordering explicit for crash injection rather than interpreting narrative as rename-before-metadata.

Default registration without state permits requests, startup barrier can fulfill on apply failure, and credential matching does not consult readiness. Normal profile deletion retains guards while failed-profile/route cleanup removes them. These are source-composed effects, not reproduced native races or global network-enforcement proof.

Promise settlement is not target exit; retries are attempt-bounded rather than deadline-bounded; source mock/lexical assertions do not prove native Windows, Electron listeners, process-incarnation or filesystem durability. Existing47 gates and all original allocations remain.
